description: Measures peak 32-bit integer (INT32) compute throughput using a long chain of integer multiply-add (MAD) instructions. All values live in registers; reports GIOPS.

scaling_param.name: mads_per_thread
scaling_param.description: Number of integer MAD operations per thread per kernel invocation; controls total compute work

non_scaling_params.name: num_blocks
non_scaling_params.description: Number of thread blocks in the grid

non_scaling_params.name: num_iterations
non_scaling_params.description: Number of timed kernel launches for averaging
